title: Sa Ngiti Mo
caption: Bright, easygoing Filipino R&B-pop love song sung in Tagalog. A smooth, smiling young male tenor with a light falsetto hook and playful ad-libs, stacked sunny harmonies. Bouncy Rhodes electric piano, a plucky clean guitar riff, warm melodic bass, a crisp mid-tempo drum groove with finger snaps and handclaps, soft synth bells. Lighthearted, sweet, helplessly charmed by a girl's smile. Modern, polished, warm production.
lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]

Pero pagbukas mo ng pinto
Nawala ang lahat ng problema ko
